its a user input error.

so check if its saying more.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] R_INLA failed
parts:
I think the issue is that you have a username on the computer with Chinese (I
presume) characters. Try setting

inla.setOption(working.directory="C:/TMP")

or somewhere where you have write access

you can upgrade INLA to the most recent version. In a more recent one, you
should get a warning if this is the case

Best
H
